name: I Am Once Again Asking For Your Financial Support
aka: Bernie I Am Once Again Asking For Your Support
look: A video still of Senator Bernie Sanders, white-haired and wearing glasses and a brown winter parka, speaking to the camera on a snowy suburban street lined with bare trees. A white subtitle at the bottom reads I am once again asking.
use: The caption finishes the subtitle with a plea the poster keeps having to repeat, like a request for help, attention or basic courtesy, delivered as a weary but persistent ask.
slots: the repeated request, finishing the subtitle (bottom)
examples: for you to wash your own dishes
to please hold a charge past lunch
describe: old man in a winter coat saying i am once again asking
senator in a brown parka on a snowy street pleading
white haired man with glasses asking for your support
bernie sanders in a jacket asking for something again
politician in a puffy coat making a request in the cold
origin: From a 2020 Bernie Sanders presidential campaign video asking supporters for donations.
